no_adcom_quote.quote: The Pulmonary and Allergy Drug Advisory Committee (PADAC) was not convened to discuss this NDA. Neither a PADAC meeting nor an external consultation was deemed necessary because the review did not raise any significant or unexpected safety or efficacy issues for this drug class or indication.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the ORLADEYO (berotralstat) NDA214094. The FDA integrated Multidiscipline Review states the Pulmonary and Allergy Drug Advisory Committee (PADAC) was not convened because the review did not raise significant or unexpected safety or efficacy issues for this drug class or indication. Consequently there was no AdComm influence on the approval.
